info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Petadoption Pets Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status API allows users to retrieve the current status of pets available for adoption. This endpoint provides essential information about each pet, including their availability and adoption status, which can aid potential adopters in making informed decisions. Typical consumers include animal shelters, pet adoption agencies, and developers building applications that facilitate pet adoptions. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can efficiently manage and monitor the status of adoptable pets.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of pets, providing information such as their availability and health status. It is useful for checking which pets are ready for adoption or require special attention.

requestBody.description: Retrieves the status of pets in the system. This request body is required to inform the server about the status options being queried.
